From 2 to 4, it's time for a crazy battle with friends! Thank you all for your continued support of Greedland! We've made a series of sweeping changes to the multiplayer system to bring you an even more thrilling co-op experience!
4-Player Co-op Mode is Live — From 2 players to 4—it's time to expand your squad! You can now fight side-by-side with 3 friends and beat those bugs to a pulp!
Independent View Feature — My Screen, My Rules! No more fighting over a single screen! Get your teammates to try the brand-new split-screen mode. Say goodbye to the old way! My screen, my rules!

Shared EXP Feature — Imagine you're in the heat of battle while your teammate is... slacking off and hoarding all the EXP. Say goodbye to that! Now, everyone shares EXP, avoiding the awkwardness of an unfair split.

Manual Upgrades — No More Suicidal Auto-Popups! This update lets you choose when to upgrade, freeing you from those "forced interruption" popups that always seem to get you killed. (This setting is also effective in single-player mode).
Come and experience this unprecedented co-op fun! The battle never stops, and the updates never end! More fresh content and optimizations are on the way, so stay tuned!

Hello everyone, I am VamP.
I've got some exciting news for you all!
Greedland is coming to Bullet Heaven Fest 2.0 with a brand new update! The new update drops on December 4th, and we've got some "special" content for you.
Along with new auxiliary gear and fusion equipment, there will be new in-game upgrades and chips. Plus, we've added a ton of new challenges and achievements.

Additionally, regional exploration missions are on the way, making in-game battles even richer. In the future, I'll be working on adding more random elements to the game maps, ensuring every battle gives you a unique experience. So get ready for the new update!
Hello, I am VaMP.

In this patch, our popular Dark Hole Generator has returned! I have fixed the previous bug, and it is finally ready to fire! You can use it to generate slowly-moving mini black holes and easily tear your enemies apart!

It has been a busy time in my real life (my son could speak now!), and I had made many preparation for the following updates. Fortunately I have basically implemented many key techniques for future development. Thus, the frequency and content of updates will surely increase. I am planning to release a big update next month! Here is my new development roadmap.
Gravity: +50% gravity
Frequency: +50% attack frequency
Size: +25% size
Extra Damage: +50% extra damage

In our 0.7.80 Update, we added tactical supplies, which allows you to purchase tactical supplies when you are close to the landing pod. The store contains some special items at the expense of some G-crystals, such as the Time Machine.
Effect: Accelerate the game speed by 100% for 300 seconds (Depends on in-game time)
My original intent for the Time Machine was, under advice of many players, to pass through the livelong mid-game in Endless Mode quickly.

In a non-Endless Mode game, the mission was not designed that long, and use Time machine earlier will cause players be overwhelmed by monsters in a sudden, and a late usage (usually after the mission time, the Time Machine effect still being activated) may cause game bugs. All those factors forced me to make a hard decision to ban it temporarily.
I am currently trying to fix the bug. Time Machine will come back to non-Endless Modes in the next patch. I am really sorry for all the inconvenience it caused.

notes.title: Greedland's First Idea Hamster Speical Event

items.text: Hello everyone, I am VaMP. Family illness issue had finally faded away, and I am planning to work on the planned things. However, I would be more than happy to use more ideas, and you could be our Idea Hamster here! Submit any creative ideas you have, maybe just a mere spark, or a well thought-out after a long time of playing. Whatever pumps out of your mind is welcomed! The coverage: Mod Name; Mod Effects. Let us have a brainstorm!
Mod Name: Exquisite Technique
Mod Effect: Automatically activate random ablility from time to time.
We will choose 1 winner at the end of the event and put his idea into the game afterwards!
The winner's name will be listed in the Credits
All ideas shall be submitted via the collection sheet (You can submit multiple times)
The duration lasts for 2 weeks (End at Jan 7th)
Idea Hamster submission link: https://forms.gle/FSc9Gs29YENqPFJE6
Official Discord of Greedland: https://discord.gg/JcVZauTksx
-Modified the interaction logic for selecting upgrade options. You can now cancel the selection after you
pressed the left mouse button, just by releasing it after moving the mouse out of the selected
upgrade card. (Previously: the clicked upgrade item was always selected no matter where you released it.)
-Modified keyboard interaction logic: from press to select upgrade to release to select upgrade.

We have recently received a lot of feedback from players with great suggestions for changes to the operation of GreedLand. We value your thoughts and thank you for your support of the game's development, and we welcome more players to give us your valuable comments and suggestions!

Hello to all players,

First of all, I would like to apologize to all of you. My son has been suffering from a fever since last week from time to time. I was fully occupied and had to rush around from hospital to home. I could only continue to develop the game after my boy took the medicine and fell asleep. Thus, planned update on 21st about in-game shop and purchasable in-run speical bonuses cannot release on time. I am sorry for the sad news to all your expectations.

items.text: Hello everyone, I'm VaMP. In this update, I've primarily added new fusion equipment and related achievements. Additionally, I've introduced automatic cloud and local save backups to reduce the chances of corrupted saves and rollbacks. Hope you enjoy the game!
New fusion equipment: Hellfire Beam. (Fused from UAV and Orbital Cannon)
Added achievement for evolving equipment. (Devastator, Electric Shuriken, Floating Laser, Boomerang, Hellfire Beam)
Added automatic cloud backup save feature and local save backup functionality to reduce the chances of data corruption and rollbacks. (unresolved issues for sudden power outages or forced log-offs)
Enhanced visual effects and performance optimizations for Orbital Cannon.
Enhanced the explosion visual effect and performance optimizations for rockets.
The lowest graphics rendering rate can now be set to 25%.
Improved in-game upgrade system, now you can remove the six options that can be upgraded infinitely. (Recovery and Refine cannot be removed).
Fixed an issue where Floating Laser did not deal additional damage when overload.

notes.title: Hello everyone, I'm VaMP. This update mainly adds a new logo for checking the cooldown time of auxiliary equipment in the pause interface as well as a prompt when getting new content, happy gaming!

items.text: The pause interface data panel will display cooldown data for auxiliary equipment
The duration of Crystal Destroyer strong magnetic effect has been increased to 1 second
Added alert logo when acquiring new equipment, battle armor, and other content
Localization update: Poland, Portugal
I welcome all of you for your feedback and suggestions in the comments! Thanks again for your support!

topNew: The pause interface data panel will display cooldown data for auxiliary equipment
The duration of Crystal Destroyer strong magnetic effect has been increased to 1 second
Added alert logo when acquiring new equipment, battle armor, and other content

items.text: New airdrop: Thunder Shield (Replaced the Isolation Shield. In addition to being immune to all damage, it can also inflict continuous damage to nearby enemies)
New equipment: Devastator (Slow to charge, but its wide-range attack can instantly kill common enemies, ineffective against elites and bosses)

New equipment: Electric Shuriken (Intermittently launches blades in all directions with the character as the center. After a period of time, the blades return to the character's position, dealing damage to all enemies in the path)

New fused equipment: Lightning Boomerang (Made from the fusion of Infinite Plasma disc and Lightning Blade. It throws boomerangs in a spiral motion around, and these boomerangs eventually return to the character)
New mods: Auto Select (Equipping this mod allows the AI assistant to select upgrades automatically during leveling up, and the upgrade interface will no longer pop up)
Added unlimited upgrade options: All Damage, Weapon Damage, Equipment Damage, Max Health, Armor, Health Recovery (previously, there were no upgrade options, only Recovery and Refine options)
New Languages: French, Polish
Removed commas for damage numbers
Reorganized sound effects and fixed some uncontrollable sound issues
Added hover and click sounds to all buttons
Ships now only land inside the circle
Rebalanced the Ice Ring skill of Vanguard: Initial duration changed to 2.5s, and initial cooldown changed to 14s
Frozen state now adds a 30% damage bonus
Added a landing pod's location display toggle
Fixed monster spawning issues in Endless Mode
Fixed the issue of incorrect bonus for Charging
Fixed the issue of insufficient bonus for Glass Cannon
Fixed the issue where pressing ESC in the equipment selection interface wouldn't return
I welcome all of you for your feedback and suggestions in the comments! Thanks again for your support!
Fixed the issue where the mouse could become unresponsive for new players entering combat for the first time.
Fixed the issue where even without selecting the co-op mode, the game could still proceed in it.
Fixed the issue where changing the limit quantity of equipment and entering the game would still result in a limit of 6.

This will allow different equipment to be combined, creating even more powerful ultimate gear. Furthermore, we will continue to develop additional weapon combinations and upgrade options.
The function cannot be used to remove the upgrade and anymore.

Modified certain sound effects.

During Steam SHMUP Fest on September 26th, we will post another major update. At that time, we will introduce a brand-new combat mechanism. Hello everyone, I'm VaMP.
In this update, I'm finally introducing the highly anticipated Endless Mode and three new weapons. Additionally, there are numerous content updates and optimizations. I hope you all enjoy these!
Unlock Endless Area in Jungle, Desert and Tundra.
Added the game instruction: You can view it in the pause menu.
New Weapon - Alpha Beam: This weapon can fire a special laser beam that reflects between enemies indefinitely until its energy is depleted, causing extensive area damage.
New Weapon - Missile Launcher: It can fire advanced tracking missiles that seek out enemies and explode, causing significant area damage.
New Weapon - Moonbeam: The fan-shaped Moonbeam possesses strong penetrating power and will damage all enemies in its path.
New Mod - Last Stand: The lower your health, the higher your damage. [Check achievement list for acquisition]
Map UI Enhancement: Display advanced mission information.
Added the feature to skip upgrade information pop-up. This feature can be enabled or disabled in the settings menu.
Added two high-score challenge achievements: Greedy Grandmaster & Greedy Deity.
The critical-related upgrades of Hyper Core were changed to [Purple Upgrades: Weakness Expert] and [Gold Upgrades: Weakness Master].
Added explanations in mods and upgrades regarding their applicability to equipment.
Raptor Drone's flight speed and acceleration increased by 20%, initial explosion radius from 192 to 200.
UAV's base damage reduced from 25 to 20.
Plasma disc: The speed upgrade reduced from 60% to 50%. Fixed issue of Infinite Plasma disc increasing rotation speed and radius.
Purple Weapon Upgrade: Charging.
Purple Weapon Upgrade: Air Cooling (requires the mod to unlock).
Heat Efficiency Upgrade increased from 20% to 25%, Cooling Upgrade increased from 20% to 25% (requires the mod to unlock).
Shotgun's impact force increased from 1 to 2, Laser Gun's impact force decreased from 2 to 1.
Rocket Launcher's initial explosion radius increased from 192 to 250, penetration and bounce upgrades now have a level 2 cap.
Weakened initial and upgraded attributes of Guardian.
Melee mod effectiveness range increased by 75%, and can cover Plasma disc's area.
Cluster Bomb, Incendiary Bomb, and Nuclear Bomb's damage gradually increases over time.
Nuclear Bomb's explosion center can instantly kill common enemies, elites and bosses are immune to that but will receive significant damage.
Vulcan's initial range increased by 100%.
Ion Shield now starts with 0.5 seconds of invulnerability.
Dash invulnerability time increased to 0.3 seconds.
Glass Cannon capacity changed to 6, and damage increase changed to 20% per level.
Overload's damage bonus effect is now calculated separately as a multiplication.
Reborn skill can now instantly kill common monsters.
The "Equipment Quantity Limit" feature has been moved to the equipment configuration interface, allowing different limits to be set for each configuration.
Mercenary remains now can yield G Crystals.
Elite monsters now drop Large G Crystals, while boss monsters drop Super G Crystals.
Upgrade and Hyper Core interfaces now display player's equipment information.
Added death lens focus effect.
Optimized explosion effect brightness.
The Landing Pod now turns on lights at night to illuminate surroundings.
Changed the sound effect for monster deaths.
Optimized blood decal performance.
Optimized damage number performance.
Optimized performance of certain special effects.
Fixed an issue where the weapon level wasn't displayed in the multiplayer equipment interface.
Fixed navigation error of controllers when clicking the Titan Mech.
Fixed cursor jumping issue in challenge mission interface.
Fixed fire rate display issue in equipment interface.
Max resolution setting now adheres to desktop resolution limit.
Fixed the incorrect cursor issue after looting remains.
Fixed issue where players with auto-shoot enabled can't automatically shoot after respawn.
Fixed certain controller issues.
Fixed the issue where Dash's invulnerability would cancel Ion Shield's invulnerability.
Fixed the issue where penetration would cause extra damage in specific situations.
Fixed the problem where changing key bindings wouldn't sync with the prompts for airdrops and hyper cores.
Added photosensitive warning.
